lessons.title: Modular arithmetic
lessons.blurb: Remainders are the clock arithmetic behind Caesar, Diffie–Hellman and RSA.

lessons.title: Primes and gcd
lessons.blurb: Primes and the greatest common divisor decide when a number has an inverse.

lessons.title: Bits and XOR
lessons.blurb: XOR is the addition the one-time pad and most of secure computation use.

paths.title: Foundations
paths.blurb: Modulo, primes and XOR. Every other path starts from these.

paths.title: Classical ciphers
paths.blurb: Remainders and XOR, then shift ciphers and the one-time pad.

paths.title: Public-key cryptography
paths.blurb: Modular arithmetic and primes, then Diffie–Hellman, RSA and elliptic curves.

paths.title: Oblivious computation
paths.blurb: XOR, then secret sharing, commitments, oblivious transfer and zero knowledge.

paths.title: Private sets
paths.blurb: Hashing and oblivious PRFs, then private set intersection and union.

paths.title: Verify a software download
